title: Code and paper for: A missing term in an explicit formula for Goldbach averages
description: Code, outputs and SHA-256 manifest for the paper showing that the explicit formula for the Goldbach average in Theorem 1 of Cantarini (arXiv:1801.08475) omits the term P(N)^2, where P(N) is the sum of N^rho/rho over the nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function, so that the remainder F(N) is not O(N) and the estimate in Conjecture 2 fails. Includes two independent exact computations of F(N) and the preprint.
keywords: zeros of the Riemann zeta function
